item.title: Google's Gemini will make its way into Dragon Quest X to power a "Chatty Slimey" AI companion, Square Enix has announced
item.description: Square Enix and Google are teaming up to deploy the Gemini chatbot on Dragon Quest X through a "Chatty Slimey" companion.

item.title: As Crimson Desert developer Pearl Abyss rushes to fix pressing issues, players are asking for updates to the time-gated dragon mount
item.description: Crimson Desert developer Pearl Abyss is deploying updates fast, but players are already complaining about major systems like temporary mounts.

item.title: After all that furore over Nvidia's AI-powered DLSS 5 makeover of Resident Evil Requiem, Capcom promises gen-AI assets won't be part of its games any time soon
item.description: Capcom says it won't be using AI tools for final in-game assets, but admits it's looking to improve efficiency and productivity somehow.

item.title: After a 90% discount, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare has more players than the past few CoD games combined on Steam
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare (2019) has received a very rare 90 percent off discount on Steam which has pushed it above other recent CoD titles.

item.title: "It's all of us against apathy, entropy, and loss of art" - Stop Killing Games has reached the EU Parliament, but what happens now?
item.description: An interview with Stop Killing Games advocate and spokesperson Josh Strfye Hayes about the future of the movement now it's visited EU parliament.

item.title: "Most North Americans and Europeans don't understand the frustrating feeling of waiting 10 minutes to find a match" - Bungie steps into help Marathon players from "isolated geographical regions"
item.description: Bungie has implemented a change to improve matchmaking for Marathon players in "isolated geographical regions".

item.title: Nintendo reportedly lowers Switch 2 production
item.description: Nintendo's Switch 2 got off to a roaring start but demand has started to sag, particularly in the US. Where are the big games to reverse this?

item.title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie age-rating accidentally confirms a 20-year-old fan theory
item.description: A ratings board listing for Nintendo's upcoming Super Mario Galaxy Movie may have just let slip a pretty major plot point.

item.title: High on Life 2's Switch 2 release delayed "to better meet not only our high standards for gaming, but yours as well"
item.description: High on Life 2, the sequel to the crude and comedic FPS from Squanch Games, has had its Switch 2 release delayed by a couple of months.
